metadata.description: Learning-with-Court workshops. Interactive technical and creative workshops that run inside Claude Code and Claude Cowork.

plugins.name: lwc
plugins.description: Run Learning-with-Court workshops in Claude. Ships the workshop-orchestrator + lesson-runner skills. MCP transport is the Custom Connector's job (Cowork) or the @learning-with-court/cli (Claude Code).

plugins.name: learning-with-court
plugins.description: Claude Code entry point for the learning-with-court catalog. After install, tell Claude Code 'set up the mcp workshop' and the plugin runs @learning-with-court/cli to sign you in (one-time browser flow), clone the workshop into ~/learning-with-court/<id>/, and hand you off to a fresh Claude Code session. Lessons are driven by the workshop's deployed MCP server, not by this plugin.
